basics.name: Jordan Alvarez
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6 years of experience building and operating backend services and data-heavy web applications. Strongest in Python and TypeScript; comfortable owning features end to end from Postgres schema to React UI. Regular open-source contributor (Apache Airflow, published PyPI provider package).

work.name: Brightline Health
work.summary: Series-B health-tech startup (~40 engineers); care-coordination platform team.
highlights: Designed and built the appointment-scheduling service (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) handling 25k bookings/day across 3 clinic networks; p95 latency held under 120 ms
Cut the nightly claims-reconciliation batch from 4.5 h to 40 min by replacing row-by-row ORM processing with set-based SQL and a Redis-backed dedupe cache
Led migration of 7 services from EC2-hosted Docker Compose to AWS ECS Fargate with blue/green deploys via GitHub Actions, eliminating deploy-window downtime
On-call owner for the scheduling domain; wrote the team's incident-response runbook and drove MTTR from ~90 min to ~25 min over two quarters
Mentored two junior engineers through their first production feature launches; ran weekly design-review sessions for the platform team

work.name: Corvid Analytics
work.summary: B2B analytics SaaS; full-stack work on the customer-facing reporting product.
highlights: Built the self-serve report builder (React, TypeScript, Redux) used by 300+ customer accounts; reduced support tickets for custom reports by 60%
Implemented a Kafka-based event ingestion pipeline (Python consumers, Avro schemas) processing ~50M events/day into a Postgres + S3 warehouse
Contributed upstream to Apache Airflow: 3 merged PRs including a fix for a sensor deadlock under high parallelism (apache/airflow#28xxx) and provider documentation improvements
Introduced contract tests between the ingestion API and consumers (pytest, schemathesis), catching 4 breaking changes before production in the first quarter
Containerized the legacy report-rendering service and moved CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, cutting median pipeline time from 22 min to 9 min

work.name: Riverbend Software
work.summary: Consultancy building custom web applications for logistics and local-government clients.
highlights: Developed a Django + PostgreSQL fleet-maintenance system for a regional logistics client, digitizing a paper process for 120 vehicles and 3 depots
Built REST APIs (Django REST Framework) with role-based access control consumed by web and mobile clients
Raised test coverage on the firm's shared Django starter kit from 30% to 85% and made it the default for new client projects

projects.name: Ledgerline
projects.description: Self-hosted personal-finance tracker with bank-CSV import, rule-based categorization, and monthly trend dashboards.
highlights: Live at https://ledgerline.app with ~400 monthly active users
FastAPI backend, React/TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL; deployed on a single VPS with Docker Compose and Caddy
Rule engine supports user-defined categorization with regex and amount predicates; 95% of transactions auto-categorized for typical users

projects.name: pgstream-watch
projects.description: Change-data-capture CLI that tails PostgreSQL logical replication slots and streams row changes to webhooks or Kafka topics.
highlights: Handles slot lag monitoring, at-least-once delivery with local WAL checkpointing, and schema-change detection
Used in production by two small teams (per GitHub issues); 210+ stars

projects.name: SketchSync
projects.description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard: multiple cursors, shape editing, and offline merge via CRDTs (Yjs) over WebSockets.
highlights: Custom WebSocket presence layer with room-based fan-out; tested to 50 concurrent editors per room
Conflict-free offline editing using Yjs document snapshots persisted to Postgres

projects.name: airflow-provider-clickhouse
projects.description: Open-source Apache Airflow provider package for ClickHouse: hooks, operators, and a bulk-load transfer operator. Published to PyPI.
highlights: 4k+ downloads/month on PyPI; maintained through three Airflow minor-version releases
Merged community PRs from 6 external contributors; CI matrix across Airflow 2.6-2.9

projects.name: loadshed
projects.description: Small Go middleware library for adaptive load shedding in HTTP services, based on tail-latency signals instead of fixed rate limits.
highlights: Implements the CoDel-inspired queue-delay heuristic; benchmarked against fixed token buckets under bursty load
